title: Draft Comprehensive README.md Structure and Content
description: Create a new, well-structured README.md file that covers all essential aspects of the 'next-shadcn-dashboard-starter' project.
details:
- Replace the existing README.md with a new file.
- Structure the document with clear headings: Project Title, Badges, Introduction, Key Features, Technology Stack, Getting Started (Prerequisites, Installation, Running Locally), Environment Variables, Deployment, Contributing, and License.
- Use the PRD and repository analysis to accurately describe the project, its features, and architecture.
- Reference package.json for scripts and dependencies, and .env.example for environment variables.
- Optionally, include a Table of Contents and badges (e.g., license, build status, Deploy to Vercel).
test_strategy: Peer review the draft for completeness, clarity, and technical accuracy. Ensure all sections are present and information is up-to-date.

title: Validate and Refine Setup and Deployment Instructions
description: Ensure the README.md contains accurate, step-by-step setup and deployment instructions that are easy to follow for new users.
details:
- Test the setup instructions on a clean environment (or simulate the process) to ensure accuracy and completeness.
- Clearly document all required environment variables, referencing .env.example.
- Provide detailed deployment steps for platforms like Vercel and Netlify, including any necessary configuration.
- Add a 'Deploy to Vercel' button for one-click deployment if possible.
test_strategy: Have a team member or peer follow the instructions from scratch and confirm successful setup and deployment. Revise any unclear or incomplete steps.

title: Add Visual Enhancements and Final Proofreading
description: Enhance the README.md with visuals (screenshots or GIFs) and perform a thorough proofreading for clarity and correctness.
details:
- Capture and embed relevant screenshots or a GIF showcasing the dashboard UI and key features.
- Ensure all Markdown formatting is correct and consistent.
- Proofread the entire document for grammar, spelling, and technical accuracy.
- Check that all links and badges work as intended.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the README.md in a Markdown viewer. Confirm that images render, links work, and text is error-free. Solicit final peer review before merging.
